title: Contact Proud Tek
summary: Proud Tek has manufactured custom RFID and NFC products in Shenzhen since 2008. Use the channel that fits your timeline — WhatsApp for quick questions, email for sample briefs, the industry-specific paths below when the deployment context already shapes the product family.
heroPoints: WhatsApp +86 186 6582 0632 for quick chip, housing or sample questions.
Email info@proudtek.com when the brief includes a spec sheet or quantity plan.
Use the industry-specific contact paths below if the deployment context is already known.

items: Most first replies arrive within one working day; urgent samples receive a same-day acknowledgement.

brief.label: Put these in the first inquiry
items: Application or industry context (hotel locks, laundry, asset tracking, branding, access control, events, vehicle).
Chip family or reader compatibility if it is already specified.
Quantity, target landed cost or delivery deadline if any are firm.
Sample expectations and preferred shipping method (DHL/FedEx/EMS).

sections.title: Pick the contact path that matches the deployment
sections.intro: If the application is already clear, the industry-specific paths below collect the right context up front. They prevent the first email from being a generic catalog request and let the engineering team pre-stage chip, housing and printing options before a sample is shipped.
bullets: Hotel and hospitality programs (key cards, room wristbands, in-room NFC).
Industrial laundry and uniform tracking (PPS, silicone, textile tag families).
RFID labels and tags for retail, supply chain or asset tracking.
RFID readers, writers and SDK procurement.
Custom RFID cards for membership, transit and secure access.
NFC branding and review cards for marketing or hospitality.
Access-control keyfobs, OEM credentials and replacement programs.
Event wristband programs (festival, conference, resort, cashless).
Vehicle RFID (parking, fleet identification, windshield tags).

sections.title: What happens after the first message
sections.intro: We treat the first reply as a scoping conversation, not a quote. The goal is to confirm the product family is correct before any tooling or sample work begins.
bullets: Step 1: confirm chip family, frequency and reader compatibility against the brief.
Step 2: align housing, printing and packaging with the deployment environment.
Step 3: ship a small sample lot for engineering validation before the first production run.
Step 4: agree on numbering, encoding, packaging and logistics for the first PO.
Step 5: lock in reorder cadence with shorter lead times once the spec is stable.

sections.title: Why buyers reach out to Proud Tek
sections.intro: The catalog is intentionally narrow — chips, housings, printing, encoding, packaging — but the program is built to support technical buyers who need answers, not a salesperson.
bullets: In-house chip programming, encoding and laser numbering.
GS1 SGTIN-96, EPC and NDEF NFC encoding for retail and brand work.
ISO/IEC 14443 and 18000-6C compliance review on every shipment.
Sample turnaround usually inside 5–7 working days for stocked chip families.
Direct factory pricing with no trading-house markup.
English-language engineering support; Chinese, Spanish and Arabic available on request.

resourceCards.title: Before sending the first email
resourceCards.description: These pages cover the questions buyers most commonly ask in the first call. Reading them first usually halves the back-and-forth.

faq.question: How quickly will I receive a reply?
faq.answer: Most first emails are answered the next working day in Shenzhen time. WhatsApp messages sent during business hours usually receive a same-day reply. Sample requests with a clear chip and housing brief move faster than open-ended catalog questions.

faq.question: Do you support OEM and white-label programs?
faq.answer: Yes. Most card, keyfob, wristband and label programs ship without Proud Tek branding by default. We support custom artwork, embossed numbering, laser engraving and bespoke packaging for resellers and integrators.

faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: Standard MOQ for stocked chip families starts at 500 pieces for cards and 1,000 pieces for tags or labels. Sample orders below the MOQ are available on a paid-sample basis when chip programming is involved.

faq.question: Can you ship outside of China?
faq.answer: Yes. Proud Tek ships globally via DHL, FedEx and EMS. We can also support sea freight on bulk orders. Customs paperwork (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, RoHS / REACH declarations) is provided for every shipment.

faq.question: Which languages are available for engineering support?
faq.answer: English is the primary working language for engineering and procurement. Chinese, Spanish and Arabic are available on request for ongoing programs.
